verdict.rationale: Trello's own site lists an official 'MCP server' that will 'Connect Trello to any AI tool', so the product itself claims the capability. The evidence is only a marketing-page label, with no setup docs, tool list, auth model, supported clients, or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: MCP server setup/connection documentation, list of exposed tools/actions, authentication and permission scoping details, independent or hands-on verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
